title: 差点 Step 6 · Say It Right: Build, Choose, Fix
description: Now you make the sentences: put the words in order, pick the right version for a situation, and catch the mistakes.

points.title: Building the sentence
points.summary: Subject + 差点(儿) + (没) + (就) + verb + (了).
points.body:
- 我 **差点儿 没** 赶上 飞机。
- 他 **差一点 就** 摔倒 **了**。
- 我 **差点 没** 认出 你 **来**！ (认出…来 = recognise)

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

**Two questions decide it**
1. Is the event something the speaker **wants** (赶上, 考上, 买到) or **doesn't want** (摔倒, 迟到, 丢)?
2. Unwanted → it **didn't happen**, with or without 没. Wanted → 差点 = didn't happen, 差点没 = **did** happen.

**Memory hooks**
- 坏事加「没」，意思不变 — for bad things, 没 changes nothing.
- 好事加「没」，意思反转 — for good things, 没 flips it.

**Mood words give it away**
- Relief (it went well): **幸亏 / 还好 / 好在** (luckily), **总算** (in the end), **好险** (that was close!)
- Regret (it didn't): **可惜** (what a pity), **就差一点** (just a tiny bit short), **真遗憾** (what a shame)
examples: I very nearly missed the plane (but made it).

points.title: Choosing 差点 or 差点没
points.summary: Decide what happened and what the speaker wanted — then pick the form from the table.
points.body:
- Wanted it and got it, barely → **差点没**.
- Wanted it and missed it → **差点**.
- Didn't want it, and it didn't happen → **差点** or **差点没**.
- Written Chinese also uses **险些** (xiǎnxiē) for 差点 with bad events: 他险些出了车祸。

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

**Two questions decide it**
1. Is the event something the speaker **wants** (赶上, 考上, 买到) or **doesn't want** (摔倒, 迟到, 丢)?
2. Unwanted → it **didn't happen**, with or without 没. Wanted → 差点 = didn't happen, 差点没 = **did** happen.

- 坏事加「没」，意思不变 — for bad things, 没 changes nothing.
- 好事加「没」，意思反转 — for good things, 没 flips it.

**Mood words give it away**
- Relief (it went well): **幸亏 / 还好 / 好在** (luckily), **总算** (in the end), **好险** (that was close!)
- Regret (it didn't): **可惜** (what a pity), **就差一点** (just a tiny bit short), **真遗憾** (what a shame)
examples: He nearly had a car accident.

points.title: Spotting mistakes
points.summary: 没 goes after 差点, 差点 goes before the verb, and the mood word must match what happened.
points.body:
- ~~我没差点迟到~~ → 我差点没迟到.
- ~~我摔倒差点了~~ → 我差点摔倒了.
- ~~可惜，我差点没买到票~~ — 可惜 (pity) doesn't fit: you got the ticket!

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

examples: What a pity — I nearly won.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{飞机|fēijī}・{没|méi}・{赶上|gǎnshàng}・{差点儿|chàdiǎnr}）
questions.explanation: 我 **差点儿 没 赶上 飞机**。
notes: 没 follows 差点儿 — slot 2.
questions.translation: I very nearly missed the plane.

questions.prompt:
{他|tā}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{就|jiù}・{了|le}・{差一点|chà yìdiǎn}・{摔倒|shuāidǎo}）
questions.explanation: 他 **差一点 就 摔倒 了**。
notes: 就 follows 差一点 — slot 2.

questions.explanation: 我 **差点 没 认出 你** 来！
notes: The person sits between 认出 and 来 — slot 4.

questions.prompt: You wanted the last cake, but the person in front of you took it. Which sentence fits?
options: {我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{买到|mǎidào}{最后|zuìhòu}{一个|yí ge}{蛋糕|dàngāo}。
{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{买到|mǎidào}{最后|zuìhòu}{一个|yí ge}{蛋糕|dàngāo}。
{我|wǒ}{买到|mǎidào}{了|le}{最后|zuìhòu}{一个|yí ge}{蛋糕|dàngāo}。
questions.explanation: Wanted it, missed it → **差点买到**. 😢
notes: 差点没买到 = you **got** it, just.
没 can't go before 差点.
questions.translation: I almost got the last cake.

questions.prompt: You slipped on the ice but grabbed the railing in time. Which sentence does **not** describe it?
questions.explanation: Only **我摔倒了** says you actually fell. The other three all mean 'almost fell'.
notes: Correct: unwanted event, 没 changes nothing.

questions.prompt: Your train left ten seconds after you jumped on. What do you tell your friend?
notes: 差点 goes before the verb.
差点赶上 = almost caught it — so you missed it.
questions.translation: I very nearly missed the train!

questions.explanation: 没 goes **after** 差点: 差点没, never 没差点.
notes: Correct: 差点儿 + verb + 了.

options: {我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{赶上|gǎnshàng}{飞机|fēijī}，{还好|háihǎo}{最后|zuìhòu}{赶上|gǎnshàng}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: 差点没买到 = you **got** the ticket — so 可惜 (what a pity) doesn't fit. Use 好险 or 幸亏.
notes: Fine: 好险 + an escaped danger.
Fine: 可惜 + a prize you missed.
Fine: made it — 还好 fits.
questions.translation: What a pity, I almost didn't get a ticket. (contradictory)

questions.prompt: 险些 (xiǎnxiē) is a written word for 差点. Which sentence means the same as 「{他|tā}{险些|xiǎnxiē}{出|chū}{了|le}{车祸|chēhuò}。」?
questions.explanation: 险些 = **差点** (written): he nearly had an accident.
notes: That's about driving carefully, not a near-accident.
questions.translation: He nearly had a car accident.

questions.prompt: 'I almost didn't recognise you — you've changed so much!' Which sentence says so?
options: {我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}，{你|nǐ}{变化|biànhuà}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}！
{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}，{你|nǐ}{变化|biànhuà}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}！
{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}，{你|nǐ}{变化|biànhuà}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}！
{我|wǒ}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}{差点|chàdiǎn}，{你|nǐ}{变化|biànhuà}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}！
questions.explanation: Recognised them, just → **差点没认出你来**.
notes: 差点认出 = almost recognised — so you didn't.
That says you didn't recognise them.
差点 goes before the verb.
questions.translation: I almost didn't recognise you — you've changed so much!

questions.prompt: 'We very nearly won the final (so close!).' Which sentence says so?
notes: 没 can't go before 差点.
questions.translation: We very nearly won the final.
